summary: Read an events page's per-event cut times and subject attributions in constant statements

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; the events feed reads the same claims and events in the same order.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites. The page's cut times are read with indexed seeks on the existing claims primary key.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Event ids, cursors, timestamps, snapshot ids, ordering and redaction are unchanged; each event keeps the acceptance time of its own cut.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption; an events page runs fewer read statements and holds no transaction longer.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions; schema and rules versions are unchanged.
